name: Joplin Server
description: Joplin Server is the sync backend for the Joplin note-taking app. Self-host it on your own server with Dokploy, which deploys Joplin Server as a Docker Compose service in a few clicks.
seoDescription: Sync backend for the Joplin note-taking app. Deploy Joplin Server with Docker Compose on Dokploy in minutes – free, open source, self-hosted.
